queries: WITH g AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g;

assumptions.assumption: 'Award vote records' means the player_award_vote table, which has a foreign key to player. manager_award_vote also has player_id but no foreign key and is a separate kind of award.
A blank death country means NULL, an empty string, or whitespace only. All of these are excluded before grouping.

The 'simple average of the group averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages over all remaining countries, including the current one. The difference is the group average minus that mean. Countries whose average is NULL are kept in the output with a NULL difference and are ignored in the mean.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote as the award vote records, combined before matching to players.

assumptions.assumption: 'Award vote records' means player_award_vote, which has a foreign key to player. manager_award_vote is not used.
A blank death country means NULL, an empty string, or whitespace only. All of these are excluded before the average of group averages is taken.

The 'simple average of the group averages' is an unweighted mean of the per-country averages across the remaining countries. It is not weighted by vote count. Countries whose points_won are all NULL have a NULL average and are left out of that mean.

A blank death country means NULL or an empty or whitespace-only string. These players are excluded before the groups are formed, so they do not enter the average of group averages.
The 'simple average of the group averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages. A country whose points_won are all NULL has a NULL average and is skipped in that mean.
